name: Markdown 美化
description: 把 .md 文件排版成易读的文档：标题编号、提示块、带行号和复制按钮的代码块、任务进度、右侧大纲和阅读进度。支持阅读 / 分栏 / 源码三种模式，边写边看，滚动同步；墨夜、纸白、书卷、终端四套主题，可导出 HTML。IDE 里的 AI 助手可以查看排版效果、读取大纲、导出 HTML。

agentTools.name: getOutline
agentTools.description: Structure of the rendered document: headings with their source line numbers, word count, reading time, code blocks, task-list progress, front-matter keys, links, and images that could not be found. Edit the Markdown source with your normal file tools; the preview updates by itself.

agentTools.name: exportHtml
agentTools.description: Save the rendered document as a standalone HTML file in the workspace (current theme, styles and local images inlined).

path.description: Output .html path relative to the workspace root.

agentTools.name: screenshot
agentTools.description: Optional mode (read, split, source; default: the reading view) and `line` to scroll the rendered document to that source line.
